record.issue_text: totalPages formula Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 is wrong for exact multiples of limit (yields 3 pages for user_count=100, limit=50), so 'next' stays enabled on the real last page and clicking it renders an empty member list

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`. For exact multiples of `limit` (e.g. `user_count=100`, `limit=50`), this yields 3 instead of 2. Since `showingLast` is `propertyEqual("currentPage", "totalPages")`, page 2 will not be considered the last page, leaving the `next` action enabled. The `next` action then sets `offset` to `Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)` which becomes `100`, and `Group.findMembers()` requests `offset=100`, returning an empty member list (server uses `limit(...).offset(offset)`).
